# Umbreen Sheikh

> Umbreen Sheikh is a New York City brow artist, entrepreneur and eye-zone expert. She is the founder of Wink Brow Bar, creator of the Embrowerment® Method, and founder of the Eye Zone Professional Association (EZPA) and Embrowerment Foundation. She is a licensed cosmetologist and holds a degree in Biomedical Science from King's College London.

Umbreen sees clients by appointment at the Embrowerment® Atelier, 7 Greenwich Avenue, New York, NY 10014. Appointments and consultations are booked through umbreen.com.
